# Upstream Archiso test fixtures

The archiso91/ and archiso92/ directories contain ten unmodified releng text
inputs from the official archlinux/archiso v91 and v92 tags. Per-file source URLs
and SHA256 values are recorded in archiso-provenance.json. These are preparation
test inputs, not a full releng profile or a trusted builder installation.

ARCHISO-LICENSE is the upstream v92 LICENSE, retrieved from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archlinux/archiso/v92/LICENSE.
The upstream license applies to these copied upstream inputs; no package
archives or private Wilsof artifacts are included.
